assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and the three key-area polygons are provisional (provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false) inferred from the public announcement; official polygons are pending release.
assumptions.impact: Site area, green ratio, public-space ratio and key-area extents must be recalculated when official boundary and key-area polygons are published; the narrative and metrics flag this as a design discussion basis only.

assumptions.statement: The KM-0 milestone system (KM-0 to KM-8), the pilgrimage landmarks and the global AI activity week are conceptual suggestions for professional deepening, not government-approved events, branding or implementation commitments.
assumptions.impact: Reviewers should treat the naming system and route proposals as design narrative; any operational roll-out needs rights clearance, event permits and operator confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are schematic rectangular footprints generated by the agent inside designated land-use zones to express scale and retain-renovate-demolish logic, not surveyed stock buildings.
assumptions.impact: Building footprint area is a design-scale metric; exact floor area, heights and massing require surveyed stock, statutory plans and engineering data.

assumptions.statement: Road centerlines are schematic route suggestions for spatial coordination; road redlines, widths, grades and station integration need statutory road plans and utility surveys.
assumptions.impact: Mobility conclusions are temporary design discussions until official road redlines and municipal data are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: All known metrics are recomputed from submitted geometry in EPSG:4548 via scripts/spatial_review.py and agree with metrics.json within tolerance.
assumptions.impact: Spatial evidence is self-consistent; metric drift after geometry edits is detected by spatial_review and blocks finalization.

assumptions.statement: Theoretical overpasses and under-bridge spaces along the park spis and the North Fifth Ring crossing nodes require structural and traffic feasibility studies.
assumptions.impact: Slow-traffic stitching projects are conditional on feasibility; the renewal project list marks these dependencies.
